title: dembrane v3: AI usage and cost
description: What AI costs and where it goes: total, per account, feature, operation and model, with budgets and trends. The same numbers and names as the staff AI costs panel, plus history. Days are UTC. Names only, never text.

list.name: account
list.label: Account
list.query: SELECT name || ' · ' || left(billing_account_id::text, 8) AS __text, billing_account_id::text AS __value FROM obs.ai_accounts ORDER BY name, billing_account_id
list.definition: SELECT name || ' · ' || left(billing_account_id::text, 8) AS __text, billing_account_id::text AS __value FROM obs.ai_accounts ORDER BY name, billing_account_id

options.content: Days are UTC. Cost panels follow the time picker (this month so far by default); cost is rounded to the day, so a range always covers whole days. The budget, percent used and override columns and the list of free accounts near their budget show where each account stands right now and do not follow the time picker. The staff AI costs panel can switch between this month and last month; on its Last month view it shows last month's budgets, so compare only the cost columns for a past month. The Account dropdown filters the By feature, By operation and By model tables; unattributed and internal spend has no account and only shows under All.

panels.title: Total spend
panels.description: All AI cost in the selected time: accounts, internal and unattributed. Same as the total of the staff AI costs panel for the same month.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0), 0) as value from obs.ai_spend where $__timeFilter(day)

panels.title: Charged to accounts
panels.description: Cost charged to a customer account (payer is account), including accounts deleted since.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0), 0) as value from obs.ai_spend where $__timeFilter(day) and payer = 'account'

panels.title: Unattributed
panels.description: Cost with no account to charge it to. Same as Unattributed in the staff panel.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0), 0) as value from obs.ai_spend where $__timeFilter(day) and payer = 'unattributed'

panels.title: Internal
panels.description: Samples, staff demos and dev tools: recorded but never charged to an account. Same as Internal in the staff panel.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0), 0) as value from obs.ai_spend where $__timeFilter(day) and payer = 'internal'

panels.title: Deleted accounts
panels.description: Cost on accounts that no longer exist at all (the account row was removed). Soft-deleted accounts still exist and show in the Accounts table as deleted. Same as Deleted accounts in the staff panel.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0), 0) as value from obs.ai_spend where $__timeFilter(day) and billing_account_id is not null and billing_account_id not in (select billing_account_id from obs.ai_accounts)

panels.title: Spend by provider
panels.description: Cost in the selected time by the provider that served the model. Unknown means the model is priced by more than one provider.

targets.rawSql: select provider, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) as cost from obs.ai_spend where $__timeFilter(day) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: This period against the previous
panels.description: Cost over the complete UTC days of the selected time (today is left out until it is over) against the same number of complete days just before, and the change in percent. Shows n/a when there is no complete day yet, or when the previous period had no cost.

targets.rawSql:
with r as (select $__timeFrom()::timestamptz as f, $__timeTo()::timestamptz as t),
w as (select cf, ct, ct - cf + 1 as n from (select (((f at time zone 'UTC') - interval '1 microsecond')::date + 1) as cf, (least((t at time zone 'UTC')::date, (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date) - 1) as ct from r) x),
s as (select n, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) filter (where day between cf and ct) as cur, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) filter (where day between cf - n and cf - 1) as prev from w left join obs.ai_spend on day >= cf - n and day <= ct group by n)
select case when n < 1 then null else coalesce(cur, 0) end as "This period", case when n < 1 then null else coalesce(prev, 0) end as "Previous period of equal length", case when n < 1 or coalesce(prev, 0) = 0 then null else round(100 * (cur - prev) / prev, 1) end as "Change" from s

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Accounts with cost in the selected time, biggest first. Cost follows the time picker; budget, percent used and override end are as of now.

targets.rawSql:
select a.name, left(a.billing_account_id::text, 8) as id, a.tier, a.account_scope as scope, s.cost as "cost in range", a.budget_micro_eur / 1000000.0 as budget, a.percent_used as "percent used", a.unlimited, a.override_until as "override ends", a.deleted
from obs.ai_accounts a join (select billing_account_id, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) as cost from obs.ai_spend where $__timeFilter(day) group by 1) s on s.billing_account_id = a.billing_account_id
order by s.cost desc, a.billing_account_id

panels.title: Free accounts at 80% of budget or more, now
panels.description: Free accounts that have used 80% or more of their AI budget this period, as of now. Not affected by the time picker.

targets.rawSql:
select name, left(billing_account_id::text, 8) as id, percent_used as "percent used", period_spend_micro_eur / 1000000.0 as "spent this period", budget_micro_eur / 1000000.0 as budget, custom_budget as "custom budget", override_until as "override ends"
from obs.ai_accounts where percent_used >= 80 and not deleted and not unlimited order by percent_used desc, name

panels.title: By feature
panels.description: Cost by feature in the selected time. Follows the Account dropdown. Share is the part of the cost shown here.

targets.rawSql:
select group_label as "group", feature, sum(calls) as calls, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) as cost, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) / nullif(sum(calls), 0) as "cost per call", sum(cost_micro_eur)::numeric / nullif(sum(sum(cost_micro_eur)) over (), 0) as share
from obs.ai_spend where $__timeFilter(day) and ('__all' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR billing_account_id::text IN (${account:sqlstring})) group by 1, 2 order by 4 desc, 1, 2

panels.title: By operation
panels.description: Cost by operation, the way the staff AI costs panel lists them, with the feature each one belongs to. Follows the Account dropdown.

targets.rawSql:
select group_label as "group", feature, operation, sum(calls) as calls, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) as cost
from obs.ai_spend where $__timeFilter(day) and ('__all' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR billing_account_id::text IN (${account:sqlstring})) group by 1, 2, 3 order by 5 desc, 3

panels.title: By model and provider
panels.description: Cost, calls and tokens by model and provider. Follows the Account dropdown.

targets.rawSql:
select model, provider, sum(calls) as calls, sum(input_tokens) as "input tokens", sum(output_tokens) as "output tokens", sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) as cost
from obs.ai_spend where $__timeFilter(day) and ('__all' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR billing_account_id::text IN (${account:sqlstring})) group by 1, 2 order by 6 desc, 1

panels.title: Spend per day by feature group
panels.description: Cost per UTC day, split by feature group.

targets.rawSql: select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time, group_label as metric, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) as value from obs.ai_spend where $__timeFilter(day) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Spend per day by model
panels.description: Cost per UTC day, split by model.

targets.rawSql: select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time, model as metric, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) as value from obs.ai_spend where $__timeFilter(day) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Unattributed and internal spend per day
panels.description: Cost per UTC day with no account to charge: unattributed, and internal (samples, demos, dev tools).

targets.rawSql: select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time, payer as metric, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) as value from obs.ai_spend where $__timeFilter(day) and payer in ('unattributed', 'internal') group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Operations without a name
panels.description: Operations the feature rules do not recognise, so they sit in the group Other. A new operation here means a name is missing. An empty operation shows as Unlabelled.

targets.rawSql:
select feature as operation, sum(calls) as calls, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) as cost
from obs.ai_spend where $__timeFilter(day) and feature_group = 'other' group by 1 order by 3 desc, 1

panels.title: Calls priced without a price, last 7 days (recent calls only)
panels.description: Calls in the last 7 UTC days whose model had no price, so their cost is missing. Only calls the app still holds in detail are counted, so this never looks further back than a week or so.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(price_missing_calls), 0) as value from obs.ai_call_quality where day > (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - 7

panels.title: Calls with estimated usage, last 7 days (recent calls only)
panels.description: Share of calls in the last 7 UTC days whose token counts were estimated because the provider reported none. Only recent calls are counted.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(usage_estimated_calls)::numeric / nullif(sum(calls), 0), 0) as value from obs.ai_call_quality where day > (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - 7
